name: Green Mining Innovation Inc.
summary: Green Mining Innovation Inc. engages in the exploration of mineral properties in the provinces of Québec and Newfoundland. It holds 100% interest in the Fortune property located in the Gaspé Peninsula, Québec; Panache North property situated in the Windfall Lake (Urban Barry) area of Québec; the Prince Property located in the province of Newfoundland; and the Upton (IMV) property located in the Monteregie region of southern Quebec. The company also holds 100% interests in the Frying Pan Island Property in Newfoundland; Anctil property situated southwest of the town of Chapais, Quebec; and the Nemenjiche property located to the south of the town of Chibougamau, Quebec. The company was formerly known as Goldstar Minerals Inc. and changed its name to Green Mining Innovation Inc. in November 2023. Green Mining Innovation Inc. is based in Québec, Canada.
